title: Ingress throttle telemetry and circuit evacuation dashboard buildout
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Background:
We currently have several token-latency SLI dashboards and regional failover visualizations, but we lack a consolidated observability surface for ingress-side throttling (what we call the ingress throttle) and the downstream circuit evacuation events that trigger multi-region failovers or priority path shedding. In incidents this quarter we've seen two issues: (1) late detection of gradual ingress pressure that later caused bulk evacuations, and (2) insufficient context in dashboards to correlate tenant pressure with circuit decisions and evacuation windows.

Goal:
Create a Grafana dashboard suite and underlying telemetry to make the ingress throttle -> circuit evacuation -> failover sequence visible and actionable. The dashboard will: (a) surface early warning signals (ingress queue depth, per-tenant enqueue rate, prefix KV hit decline), (b) show circuit controller decisions (threshold crossovers, hysteresis windows, evacuation start/end times), and (c) provide tenant-level pressure and SLO impact views for incident responders and SRE.

Acceptance criteria (must pass for Done):
1) Dashboard contains panels for: Ingress throttle rate heatmap, Queue depth (global + per-region), Evacuation timeline with annotated circuit state transitions, Tenant pressure scoreboard (top 50 by enqueue rate delta), and Synthetic prober p95/p99 traces mapped to region.
2) Panels use production metric names and PromQL queries verified by infra monitoring team.
3) Evacuation timeline is correlated with logs (circuit-controller events) and exposes links to the runbook/playbook entry for immediate remediation.
4) Alerting: create one low-sensitivity early-warning alert (P2) that triggers when rolling 5m ingress rate increases by >150% and prefix-kv-hit drops by >20% for the same tenant cohort.
5) Dashboard rollout to canary org and two SREs for feedback; no regressions in quota or billing dashboards.
6) Documentation: Confluence page with design decisions, PromQL examples, and troubleshooting steps.

Design notes and telemetry sources:
- Metrics to ingest (priority): ingress_enqueue_rate{region,tenant,route}, ingress_queue_depth{region,shard}, circuit_state{region,shard,policy}, circuit_evacuations_total{region,tenant}, kv_prefix_hit_ratio{route,prefix}, decode_path_latency_tokens_p99.
- Sources: eBPF enqueue timing, runtime export (tokencounter subsystem), and circuit-controller event stream (Kafka topic: circuit-events-prod). We'll enrich events in the metrics pipeline with tenant and route tags at ingestion.
- Visualization specifics:
  * Ingress throttle heatmap: x-axis time, y-axis tenant cohort percentiles (90/95/99), color = enqueue_rate normalized by tenant baseline (baseline = median 14-day).
  * Evacuation timeline: discrete state bands per region; overlay annotations for: policy ramp start, evacuation_start, evacuation_end, and fallback route activations. Each annotation links to runbook URL.
  * Hysteresis visualizer: dual-axis showing threshold value and live metric; when threshold toggles, show shaded hysteresis window. Useful to tune hysteresis width.
  * Tenant pressure scoreboard: sortable by enqueue rate increase, p99 latency delta, and KV-hit regression. Drilldown links to tenant SLO page.

Trade-offs considered:
- Granularity vs ingestion cost: we considered per-token timing for all requests but decided to sample tails for p99 and otherwise use aggregated per-token counters to keep cost low. Sampling rule: full tail traces for tenants > 1M tokens/day; 1% sampling for others.
- Event correlation: shipping the circuit-events stream to metrics introduces ~3s lag. We add a secondary fast-path: short-lived in-memory router trace that emits immediate annotations for the dashboard during incidents. This adds complexity but improves time-to-detection for incident response.

Implementation tasks (owner in parens):
1) Metric schema and pipeline mapping (Infra/Monitoring): add ingress_enqueue_rate, annotate circuit events with tenant tags (Liam).
2) PromQL queries and panel mocks (Eng Observability): author queries, create panel JSONs with placeholders (Ava).
3) Grafana dashboard creation + UIDs (Ava): create dashboards for canary org. Set UID: "evac-dashboard-220556".
4) Alert rule and escalation policy (SRE): low-sensitivity early-warning alert; link to on-call runbook (Maya).
5) Synthetic prober integration (QA): add prober p95/p99 traces to the dashboard and link prober results to SLO page (Ben).
6) Documentation and playbook (Docs): Confluence page with queries and troubleshooting steps (Ava).
7) Canary rollout and feedback collection (Owners: SRE + Eng Obs): 1-week canary with two SREs.

PromQL examples (to be reviewed with monitoring team):
- Ingress enqueue rate baseline-normalized (5m):
  sum by (tenant) (rate(ingress_enqueue_count[5m])) / sum by (tenant) (historical_ingress_median_14d)
- Circuit evacuations per region (1m):
  increase(circuit_evacuations_total[1m]) by (region)
- KV hit regression signal (30m):
  (avg_over_time(kv_prefix_hit_ratio[30m]) - avg_over_time(kv_prefix_hit_ratio[14d])) / avg_over_time(kv_prefix_hit_ratio[14d])

Rollout plan:
- Phase 0 (this ticket): build dashboard with placeholder queries, wire event annotations, and create docs.
- Phase 1 (canary): deploy to canary org + SRE reviewers (2025-02-19 to 2025-02-25). Collect feedback and metrics on noise.
- Phase 2: iterate and push to production orgs; create alerting in PagerDuty and link runbook (target 2025-03-05).

Acceptance test steps (manual):
1) Run synthetic spike (synthetic-prober job id: prober-evac-002) against canary org and verify dashboard shows ingress heat spike, raises early-warning alert, and records an evacuation annotation.
2) Verify links from evacuation annotation open the correct runbook and GitHub PRs for prior configuration changes.
3) Verify tenant scoreboard drilldown resolves to the tenant SLO page and shows baseline comparisons.

Open questions / blockers:
- We need monitoring infra to add tenant annotation enrichment to circuit-event ingestion (blocked on infra ETA).
- Confirm cost budget for increased tag cardinality for ingress_enqueue_rate (billing/infra review requested).

Notes from reviews (timeline):
- 2025-02-12 - Design review (SRE): "Hysteresis visualizer is very helpful; ensure we expose the configured hysteresis window as a metric so dashboard isn't guessing." (Maya).
- 2025-02-14 - Security review: no secrets required; confirm Kafka ACLs for event topic (sec).
- 2025-02-16 - PM feedback: add a tenant-impact summary at top of dashboard to help PMs triage customer calls quickly (Jordan).

Next steps (short term):
- Finalize PromQL with monitoring team (Liam).
- Land PR #8421 (Ava) and request infra to enable tenant enrichment for circuit-events.
- Schedule canary window and notify SRE rotation.
